identity_guard: This gate applies to the CFE-informed STANDARD dataset, not the matched CFE experimental pack.
purpose: Prevent LHIT from collapsing back into a Capybara/multi-turn/chat bucket. Final Standard Uplift admission requires qualified consequential-history coverage wherever the same consequence structure reasonably appears.
laws: SINGLE-RECORD EPISODE CAN CARRY CONSEQUENTIAL HISTORY
APPLY LHIT WHERE CONSEQUENCE STRUCTURE EXISTS; DO NOT FORCE IT INTO TRIVIAL EPISODES

required_structures: earlier state/config/assumption becomes causally relevant later
failure/revision localizes to dependencies while unrelated valid work survives
repeated failure can become a reusable regression/failure boundary
competing hypotheses remain live across evidence changes
later evidence changes qualification/currentness of earlier claims
identifying experiment or discriminator can be selected
unresolved seams can persist without rhetorical closure
past actions/observations alter later feasible actions
tool observation can revise a plan
resource/authority/currentness changes propagate through dependent steps
unaffected completed work survives replanning
earlier derivation state is reused later
local contradiction/error triggers scoped recomputation
verification can alter confidence/trajectory rather than decorate the answer
later non-negating evidence can make earlier memory inapplicable
currentness propagates through indirect consequences
unrelated memories survive state revision
model/world residual creates competing explanations
new measurement requalifies earlier hypotheses
measurement choice can be discriminating rather than merely supportive
persistent residual can trigger model/representation refinement
early state becomes causally binding later
revisit occurs after dependency/state change
contradiction recovery preserves unrelated state
unresolved seam can remain live until a later discriminator

pass_conditions: Every required domain family has non-trivial qualified coverage after license, contamination, dedup, quality and invariant review.
Coverage is measured by stripped consequence structures, not donor labels or source quotas.
At least some LHIT-style episodes are single-record/non-chat examples where appropriate, proving the corpus did not encode LHIT as conversation shape only.
Cross-domain isomorphs and anti-isomorphs exist so the learner cannot solve by surface format recognition.
Currentness/revision episodes include indirect propagated consequences, not only explicit corrections.
Code/debugging and research episodes include preserved unaffected state after revision, not only full-reset fixes.
Final coverage report shows no required family as MISSING or UNASSESSED.
claim_ceiling: The v2 intake now screens cross-domain LHIT candidates, but this gate intentionally blocks any claim that the final Standard Uplift dataset has complete LHIT coverage until missing domains are sourced/generated, qualified and admitted.
